record.paper_title: The cosmological constant, dark matter, supersymmetry, and other unsolved problems from a fresh perspective
record.original_question: What inflation-like mechanism operated in the early universe, if a fundamental theory is to account for early-universe cosmology beyond the standard cosmological model?

evidence.quote: Examples are the origin of Yukawa couplings, the origin of the Higgs boson mass, the nature of dark energy, an inflation-like mechanism in the early universe

artifact.status_search_result: The question of identifying a first-principles inflation-like mechanism for the early universe remains an open problem in theoretical cosmology and high-energy physics. Many candidate models exist (single-field slow-roll inflation, Starobinsky R^2 inflation, string-landscape inflation, Higgs inflation, ekpyrotic/bouncing alternatives, etc.), but none is established as the correct fundamental mechanism, and recent reviews continue to treat the origin of inflation as unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Inflation (cosmology) — overview
status_evidence.snippet: The physical origin of the inflaton field and the precise model of inflation remain unknown; multiple competing models are consistent with current data.
status_evidence.claim: No fundamental mechanism for inflation is established.

status_evidence.title: Planck 2018 results. X. Constraints on inflation
status_evidence.snippet: A wide class of inflationary models remains compatible with CMB data; the underlying microphysical mechanism is not determined.
status_evidence.claim: Inflationary mechanism is not pinned down by observations.
